name: 78722 · Austin, TX
findings: ZIP 78722 (Austin) has 49 nonprofit organizations. 37 of them (76%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78722 (Austin) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 78722 (Austin) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 12% of all organizations here have no identified type.
